content: I don't think the contributor, https://github.com/thiagolepidus , is here on Zulip.
But I thought I'd kick off a topic anyway.
@Alyssa Conlon maybe we could add it to the next meeting agenda.
I left some comments if they're helpful! The PR is also waiting for some workflows to be approved
Ah, thanks, I just clicked the button to approve the workflows.
That's interesting :eyes: yes, let's talk about it at the December meeting!
Will the feature be added to 6.13? Or is it still under review and development? @Philip Durbin 🚀

Officially, it has a status of "Ready for Triage" so it hasn't been advanced to "Ready for Review" yet.

On what we call "Triage Tuesday" we go through all the new open pull requests, like this one. You can see the queue here. It's pretty rare that we don't advance a PR to "Ready for Review". But that doesn't necessarily mean it'll make it into 6.13, though, which already has a lot of pull requests waiting to be reviewed, tested, and merged. You can see the list here.
It's a good problem to have... so many pull requests from the community! :sweat_smile:
